geographic_notes.text: Source dated 2023 reports: Rice-growing irrigation zones around Pomeroon, Demerara and Berbice depend on drainage and seawater control along the low coastal plain.

Source dated 2023 reports: Hinterland Amerindian communities face differentiated flood/drought vulnerability linked to poverty and location; the report separately describes mining/logging-related migration and Venezuelan arrivals in Region 1.

Source dated not stated reports: During the 2009–2010 drought, East Demerara Water Conservancy fell below the designated safe irrigation level, illustrating reservoir dependence during dry conditions.

Source dated not stated reports: FAO lists elevated interior child-labour vulnerability in Regions 1, 7, 8 and 9 using 2019/2020 information and describes land-title barriers limiting female-headed farms’ credit access.

Source dated 2018-05-03 reports: The Region 8 tenure synopsis reports customary land excluded during titling/demarcation and resulting boundary disputes; 14 of 15 titled study villages reported no consultation or consent to granted areas.
Source dated 2018-05-03 reports: Participating Region 8 communities called for resolving third-party land conflicts, respecting prior informed consent and dialogue on collective Patamona territory.

known_gaps.text: No countrywide causal estimate of climate impacts on conflict or violence is established by these sources.
